subject.title: Contain Codex interleaved overcount and add fork provenance fixtures (#2037)

question: Is conservative undercount after detecting interleaved counters acceptable as an interim replacement for the current multiplicative overcount?
rationale: Tests can prove that the algorithm no longer inflates usage, but maintainers must decide whether intentionally lower estimates are acceptable until stable event or lineage provenance is implemented.

options.title: Accept bounded containment
options.body: Merge after affected-environment proof and continue exact provenance work in the canonical issue.

options.title: Wait for exact provenance
options.body: Hold the PR until accounting can avoid both multiplicative overcount and intentional smaller-lineage undercount.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded containment
recommendation.body: Merge after affected-environment proof and continue exact provenance work in the canonical issue.
